criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Frames 1, 4 and 9 pass most of the showstopper test and 6 is a clean turn. Four fall short. 8 is a primitive pendant in a flat blue void, its post touching 'cell.' and its knob under the cite line. 7 is a flat line drawing with one relief part, a UI-like tab and a weak lower zone. 2 sits in the grey middle with an unexplained dark wedge for the rolled corner. 3's 312 pockets read as a texture, the lifted part about 12 px in the thumb, a dark band between dek and tray. Frame 2's squares follow the declared scale.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One deck: the part motif on 1, 3 and 7, cyan only for Hadrian on 6, 7 and 9, 6 reusing 5's bench and light, dark value without strobing. Frame 8's cold blue backdrop sits outside a warm machine shop, and 7's cyanotype cools the run from 7 to 8.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces to figures.json and a quoted claim, the drawn-only values are computed and never printed, Dallas County comes from TDLR, the jobs are statewide, the 24 kept apart from the 100. Looser points: frame 3's mixed-period division, frame 7's 'own factories' gloss with c22 on the same page, frame 2's 'operation' for 'manufacturing footprint'.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What, who, where and when are given, Dallas County only in the caption. Nothing to do, no hiring route, no public body. The AI angle resolves as 'the release never says'.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: The cover does not say why a feed reader should care. Frames 2 to 5 spend four frames on inventory before the cell returns on 6. The turn at 6 is real and 7 and 8 build the question well. The close lands softly.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean, careful, no boosterism, a good caption opener. Elsewhere a fact-checker's ledger: frame 3's line is awkward and frame 9's is hedge on hedge. No regional texture beyond the city name.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: The machine-shop world and the cyanotype are new. Frames 5 and 6 repeat no. 54's block beside slots, the taped bays repeat no. 55, the isotype is the house move for the fourth deck running, and the turn is again an absence.

one_sentence_fix: Cut one of the inventory frames 2 to 5 so Hadrian's empty bays arrive by frame 5, and rewrite the cover hook around a 24-machine automated cell coming to a missile plant whose release never says what the AI will do.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A primitive pendant in a flat blue void, the post touching the dek, the knob under the cite line.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Model the pendant at full detail against the shut door and graphite enclosure under the warm low key, the arm below the dek and the housing bleeding off the bottom.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A flat line drawing with one relief part, a UI-like tab, footer inside the border, a weak lower zone.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Shoot the sheet at a raking three-quarter angle with a curled corner and a long cast, bleeding off the bottom, and a physical tape tab.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Grey middle, a UI diagram, the rolled corner an unexplained wedge.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Near-grazing key and a darker slab so only the joint lips and form boards catch light, the carpet corner a visible curl with its own highlight.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: 312 pockets read as texture, the lifted part tiny, a dark band above the tray.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Raise the tray to just under the dek and set an enlarged lifted part near the camera above its empty pocket with a strong cast.

transcribed: by the showrunner from the judge's hand-back, scores and totals as returned, reasons abridged
